Inspect a compound's CAMERA grouping performance

inspect_compound.Rd

For a given compound name, presents a compound-centric evaluation of CAMERA's pcgroup assignments using pre-built evaluation objects from the MS1Match functions. Handles compounds with multiple chromatographic instances (suffix _1, _2, etc.) automatically.

Unlike the MS1Match functions which operate across all compounds, this function filters the pre-built objects to the queried compound and presents results in a human-readable format. The only computation performed internally is building the feature-level long_table, which is unique to the per-compound view.

Usage

inspect_compound(
  compound_query,
  eval_full,
  anchors,
  compound_eval_wide,
  anno_accuracy,
  purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT,
  ppm_tol = 10,
  print_detail = TRUE
)

Arguments

compound_query

character(1). Compound name to search for. Matches exact name or name with numeric suffix (e.g. "L-Norvaline" matches "L-Norvaline", "L-Norvaline_1", "L-Norvaline_2"). Special regex characters are automatically escaped.

eval_full

data.frame. Master evaluation table from build_eval_full. Required columns: feature_name, Compound_name, Lib_group, reference_tier, mz, rt, pcgroup, camera_adduct, adduct_match.

anchors

data.frame. Anchor table from build_anchors. Required columns: Lib_group, anchor_feature, anchor_pcgroup.

compound_eval_wide

data.frame. Per-compound wide evaluation table from build_compound_eval. Used for tier summary counts.

anno_accuracy

list. Output of build_anno_accuracy. The per_compound element is used for annotation accuracy counts.

purity

list. Output of build_pcgroup_purity. The all_pcgroups element is used for pcgroup context statistics.

CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT

data.frame. CAMERA-annotated feature table. Must contain: feature_name, pcgroup. Optionally: adduct (or camera_adduct), isotopes.

ppm_tol

numeric(1). ppm tolerance for annotation accuracy check. Default 10.

print_detail

logical(1). If TRUE (default), prints a formatted summary to the console / Rmd output.

Value

Invisibly returns a named list with three elements:

long_table

Feature-level detail table for the queried compound. Columns: Compound_name, Lib_group, feature_name, mz, rt, tier_simple, our_annotation, camera_pcgroup, camera_location, camera_adduct, camera_isotopes.

tier_summary

Filtered rows from compound_eval_wide with annotation accuracy columns joined from anno_accuracy$per_compound.

pcgroup_purity

Filtered rows from purity$all_pcgroups for the anchor pcgroup(s) of this compound.

Tier definitions

TierDescription
Tier1aConfirmed adduct match via direct library matching
Tier1a_expAdduct match via Phase 2 full-FT expansion
Tier1bIsotope peaks (Phase 1)
Tier1b_expIsotope peaks found in Phase 2 expansion
Tier1cIn-source MS2 fragments
Tier1dNeutral loss pairs
Tier2Unexplained co-eluting features

See also

build_eval_full, build_anchors, build_compound_eval, build_anno_accuracy, build_pcgroup_purity

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
eval_full          <- build_eval_full(anno_result$export_feature_compound_summary,
                                      CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT)
anchors            <- build_anchors(eval_full)
purity             <- build_pcgroup_purity(CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT,
                                           eval_full, anchors)
compound_eval_wide <- build_compound_eval(eval_full, anchors, purity)
anno_accuracy      <- build_anno_accuracy(eval_full, anchors, ppm_tol = 10)

result <- inspect_compound(
  compound_query           = "L-Norvaline",
  eval_full                = eval_full,
  anchors                  = anchors,
  compound_eval_wide       = compound_eval_wide,
  anno_accuracy            = anno_accuracy,
  purity                   = purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT = CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT
)

write.csv(result$long_table, "L-Norvaline_detail.csv", row.names = FALSE)
} # }
